title: systemd service state model
summary: Read load, active, sub-state and result evidence without confusing recorded state with root cause.

concepts.title: Load state
concepts.explanation: Shows whether the unit definition was loaded and whether a load error occurred.

concepts.title: Active and sub-state
concepts.explanation: Describe lifecycle state at different levels of detail.

concepts.title: Result
concepts.explanation: Records the service manager result for a completed or failed operation.

limitations: Active does not prove application-level health.
reset-failed clears recorded failure state and counters; it does not repair the cause.
